name: 华夫格织纹厨房洗碗抹布款
description: 白底叠码主图接拧水卖点、织纹微距与成套陈列的八镜厨房纺织套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and trust layout, warm milk-white #F6EFE6 for info and comparison panels, airy near-white kitchen field #FBF8F4 and pale painted-brick wall #F1EDE8 for scenes
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright high-key daylight-balanced studio light around 5500K, front-left softbox key with white bounce fill, soft contact shadows, low sweeping skimming highlight on textile texture, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte beige stone-look counter #E9DFD1, white ceramic basin #F4F3F1, pale painted-brick wall #F1EDE8, fabric field in misted slate #5C626C
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; one short headline in a rounded pill chip plus small pill labels, all rendered copy kept as placeholders and never dense body text
styleLock.iconSystem: flat thin single-weight line icons in the accent colour #E4572E, no fill, maximum one icon per screen
styleLock.presentationRules: folded stack, single draped piece and spread square keep one consistent scale across the set; the weave face always stays readable and props never cover it; hands may enter frame but never a face
noDrift: no invented numbers or certification marks on spec screens
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean bright kitchen textile visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless pure white #FFFFFF, warm milk-white #F6EFE6, misted slate fabric #5C626C and one accent #E4572E; neutral high-key daylight around 5500K with a front-left soft key, white bounce fill and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with one rounded pill headline and small pill labels; flat thin-line icon style in the accent colour only; matte stone counter and pale painted-brick surface language; stable folded-stack and spread-square scale with the weave face always readable; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no invented numbers or certification marks.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用整齐叠码与拱起顶条展示成套件数与织纹
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level view, stack turned a few degrees, full stack visible and uncut
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front key with white bounce fill, soft contact shadow under the base
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, even margin on all four sides
shots.promptTemplate: Product packshot of {product}: a neat stack of folded textile pieces with the top piece arched forward into a soft tunnel so the woven face and the folded edges both read. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed straight-on at eye level with the stack turned a few degrees, full stack visible and uncut by the frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and a white bounce fill on the shadow side, and one soft contact shadow pooling under the base so the stack never floats. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace beyond an even margin. 8K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no hang tag or woven label lettering, no brand wordmark, no hands, no props, no watermark, no extra text, no tinted or gradient background, no floating stack without a contact shadow, no cut-off edges, no duplicated pieces.

shots.intent: 一秒讲清含水面主张，用双手拧出大量清水的动作坐实卖点
shots.camera: very low angle looking upward from just above the basin rim, wringing hands sitting high in frame
shots.lighting: bright high-key daylight 5600K through a sheer curtain behind, white front fill, tiny speculars on falling water
shots.background: airy near-white kitchen field #FBF8F4 with a sheer curtain
shots.props: white basin edge, wooden plate rack with plain plates at the right, two hands

shots.textZone: 左上角圆角胶囊标题位与其下方细线图标位

Bright high-key daylight at 5600K filtering through a sheer curtain behind the hands, plus a white front fill, with small speculars catching the falling water. Airy near-white kitchen field #FBF8F4 with a wooden plate rack holding plain plates at the right. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, with generous negative space in the upper left for one rounded headline chip reading 「{selling_point_1}」 and one flat thin-line icon beneath it. shots.lighting: even soft studio light from the upper left at 5500K, faint contact shadow under each fold, identical on both sides
shots.background: left panel soft white #FFFFFF, right panel warm milk-white #F6EFE6, divided by a thin gutter
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace beyond the thin gutter between the two panels
shots.textZone: 顶部横向标题条位与两栏底部胶囊标签位
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison screen, two matched panels split by a thin vertical gutter. Left panel: the folded corner of {product} pressed flat and dense. Right panel: the same folded corner of the same {product} opened back up with a plump lofted edge. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Matched tight close-ups at eye level with identical crop, lens height and framing on both sides so only the fabric state differs. Even soft studio light from the upper left at 5500K with a faint contact shadow under each fold, the same light logic in both panels. Left panel background soft white #FFFFFF, right panel background warm milk-white #F6EFE6, one short headline chip reading 「{callout_1}」 across the top band and one small pill label reading 「{callout_2}」 under each panel. The two states together occupy 55-60% of the frame with no extra whitespace beyond the thin gutter. Negative: no fabricated before-and-after results, no second competing product, no brand wordmark, no invented percentages or figures, no mismatched lighting or scale between panels, no more than two lines of copy, no watermark.

shots.intent: 全家福平铺加空白凭证框收口降风险，为下游资质留位

shots.props: one row of empty rounded seal frames, one blank proof line, no lettering

Even high-key flat studio lighting with only faint contact shadows under each fold and no dramatic falloff, so every piece reads at the same scale. Below the layout sits one row of empty rounded seal frames and one blank proof line, plus one short neutral line reading 「{callout_3}」 above them, with every frame left unlettered for post production. provenance.notes: 7 张源主图逐图事实：001 纯白底多条整齐叠码、顶条前拱成隧道、侧角缝有一枚红色织唛字标；002 深灰织纹满幅微距、左下圆形放大镜框加虚线引出英文字标；003 双手在白瓷水槽上方拧出大量清水、右侧木质碗碟沥架与纱帘、左上圆角胶囊英文字标与细线水滴图标；004 正俯视白瓷水槽皂沫中擦洗透明玻璃盘、琥珀玻璃碗与金属龙头入镜；005 台面摊平一条并以平放手掌作比例锚点、前与右双向尺寸箭头（数值不入稿）；006 白砖墙前两条挂勾成三角垂坠、台面再叠摊两条，配竹板、擀面杖、果蔬篮与印花隔热垫；007 双栏同框对比同一折角压紧与回弹状态、顶部英文字标条与两栏胶囊标签。品类判定：无电加热与电机的小件厨房纺织用品，源提示偏厨房用品，但套图语言以织纹微距、挂垂成形与成套叠码为主，故判为家居日用-家纺布艺，leaf 取华夫格织纹厨房抹布。已剥离内容：原品牌字标与红色织唛、图内全部英文原句（吸水主张、材质百分比、尺寸数值、压缩与洗涤字样、道具上的英文字）、原平台店铺字样与评分促销角标、手部饰品与任何可辨识人物特征；产品一律以 {product} 占位，规格与凭证位一律留空或用占位符。
